name: Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce
author: WooXperto

sections.description:
Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce Plugin is a comprehensive giveaway or lottery solution. This system is designed for selling giveaway or lottery tickets and doing a draw in a fare way (random winner selection). Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce Plugin is a complete solution for giveaway system. It’s built on top of WooCommerce that’s why Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce plugin completely capable to work with any other woocommerce extensions like- discount rules plugins, dynamic pricing plugins, coupons plugins, variation swatches etc. That means Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce plugin is compatible with your existing woocommerce system without any hassle. Let’s try it out.

🖥️Live Demo: View Demo

Key Features

Our Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce Plugin comes with following features: –

👉 Number of Tickets setup foreach unit quantity
Setup how many tickets / entries will be obtain a single quantity buy.

👉 Giveaway specific ticket selling start date & time setup
Setup when the giveaway ticket selling will be started.

👉 Giveaway specific ticket selling close date & time setup
Setup when the giveaway ticket selling will be stopped/closed

👉 Giveaway specific draw date & time setup
Define when the giveaway will draw

👉 Allocate tickets by setting ticket range
You have freedom to setup, how many tickets you want to sell for a giveaway.

👉 Send tickets through email
You have a control to send individual ticket in a beautiful look to your customer through email.

👉 Add your logo into ticket
You can add your logo into ticket, that might enlighten your brand more.

👉 Beautiful giveaway draws countdown timer
Show countdown timer at shop/archive page as well as single giveaway page.

👉 Giveaway ticket sold status
It comes with a ticket sold progress bar that represents allocated vs sold tickets status.

👉 Giveaway Reveal System (Random Winner Selection)
Giveaway Lotteries for WooCommerce plugin offers a random winner selection system with countdown timer. It’s an automatic system, when the draw time reach winner will be announced with a beautiful firework.

**Many more options that will be helpful for your giveaway business. Let’s try it out.

**WooXperto Team is open for you to give customization support. You might contact us for any kind of help for your giveaway system.

Let’s Enjoy 😊

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files: Upload the giveaway-lottery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Install Required Plugins: Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin: Go to ‘Giveaway Settings’ under WooCommerce settings to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. Will this plugin work with products?

Yes It’ll work with all type of WooCommerce product like- simple, variable, subscription etc.

2. Can I sell ticket quantity based packages like- 5 tickets for $10, 10 tickets for $15, 20 tickets for $20 so on?

Yes you can. You just need to create a variable product which will be a giveaway. Then you can put correct number of tickets for each variation.

3. Have this plugin any reveal or draw option?

Yes it has.

4. Can I export all sold tickets for a giveaway?

Yes, you can. You’ll get export option under products in backend.
